ALLO_B2M_HLAE_CD47_SWAP_CIITA_KO.label: B2M-ISRE::[EEF1A1-core+intron]-HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL)-GSG-P2A-CD47-IgV-GPI-WPREmut6 (or 2A-Free Bidirectional Arm 1B) + CIITA-/-
ALLO_B2M_HLAE_CD47_SWAP_CIITA_KO.description: 2 chromosomal cuts (B2M exon 1 knock-in via single-AAV6 [Arm 1B 2A-free bidirectional: 3,974 bp donor / 4,264 bp with ITRs <= 4,700 bp limit] or non-viral linear dsDNA/ceDNA HDR [Arm 1A bicistronic: 4,880 bp donor / 5,170 bp with ITRs; Shy et al. 2023 PMID:36008610 supports a different nonviral editing context; exact ceDNA/Arm 1A delivery in hPSCs remains unvalidated; note that bacterial IS110 Bridge-RNA recombinases in Durrant et al. 2024 PMID:38926615 and Pelea et al. 2026 PMID:41642947 are exploratory and not validated in human iPSCs] + CIITA biallelic KO). Eliminates classical HLA-A/B/C and HLA-II direct presentation while co-expressing single-chain HLA-E*01:03 (HLA-A2 VMAPRTLVL leader; ~12% overlap with clinical HCMV UL40 isolates per Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229, vs optional cytoplasmic KW-motif retention-signal removal per He et al. 2025 PMC12582296) and CD47-IgV-GPI placed at the 3' cistron so the 37-aa DAF GPI signal resides at the true extreme C-terminus without a 2A peptide scar (note membrane topology per Audit R01: because HLA-E*01:03's C-terminal cytoplasmic tail resides in the cytosol whereas Furin's catalytic domain is lumenal inside the trans-Golgi network, Furin is omitted and HLA-E*01:03 retains the 21-aa cytosolic -GSG-P2A peptide tail in Arm 1A, compared head-to-head in Stage-0 Decision Experiment #1 against scarless 2A-free bidirectional Arm 1B [SV40pA-CD47-IgV-GPI(antisense) <- EEF1A1-core | Syn_5xISRE_minP -> HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL)-bGHpA]; PMID:38508139, PMID:37156915, PMID:37820008). Subject to Hour-0 resting B2M-promoter surface density verification (Graveyard 009; Han et al. 2019 PMID:31040209).

ALLO_HLA_C_RETAINED_SUPERDONOR_PLUS_TYK2.label: HLA-A-/- + HLA-B-/- + CIITA-/- (Retaining 1 matched HLA-C allele) + TYK2-/-
ALLO_HLA_C_RETAINED_SUPERDONOR_PLUS_TYK2.description: 4 chromosomal cuts (HLA-A KO + HLA-B KO + CIITA KO + TYK2 KO). Retains 1 recipient-matched HLA-C allele (Xu et al. 2019 PMID:30853558) for KIR2DL C1/C2 NK self-recognition and viral surveillance while blocking IFN-alpha-induced MHC-I hyper-expression via TYK2-/- (PMID:36289205); note that whereas the -21M/-21T leader dimorphism is primarily an HLA-B polymorphism and HLA-C typically encodes -21M (Ramsuran et al. 2018 PMID:29302013), deleting HLA-A and HLA-B removes the dominant HLA-A/-21M HLA-B leader supply so endogenous HLA-E stabilization must be verified empirically (Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229), and co-targeting linked HLA-A (~chr6:29.94 Mb) and HLA-B (~chr6:31.35 Mb) in cis carries a ~1.41 Mb interstitial deletion/LOH hazard across the intervening HLA-C locus (~31.27 Mb) unless executed sequentially or verified by long-read/ddPCR copy-number gating.

ALLO_B2M_CIITA_KO_CD47_LENTI.label: B2M-/- + CIITA-/- + Constitutive Lentiviral CD47 OE (Sana UP421 / HIP benchmark)
ALLO_B2M_CIITA_KO_CD47_LENTI.description: 2 CRISPR nuclease DSB knockouts (B2M-/-, CIITA-/-) + 1 semi-random lentiviral CD47 integration (counted as K_total_genomic_modifications = 3 in the uniform locus budget, with K_crispr_dsb = 2 and K_lentiviral_integration = 1; Finding 025). Validated in NHP and n=1 human forearm intramuscular sentinel implant (PMID:37156915, PMID:40757665; 14-month follow-up correspondence in Carlsson et al. 2026 PMID:42430558, which carries zero quantitative weight in target_profiles because PubMed indexes NEJM correspondence without an abstract).

ALLO_B2M_KO_PDL1_A20_KI.label: B2M-/- + PD-L1 KI + TNFAIP3 (A20) KI (CRISPR/ViaCyte VCTX210 benchmark, CIITA WT)
ALLO_B2M_KO_PDL1_A20_KI.description: 3 genomic edits (B2M KO + PD-L1 KI + TNFAIP3/A20 KI) without CIITA KO or CD47/HLA-E NK shield (VCTX210 clinical trial NCT05210530).

ALLO_NONE_UNEDITED_OR_SYSTEMIC_IMMUNOSUP.label: Unedited Wild-Type Allogeneic HLA (Vertex VX-264 macrodevice or zimislecel / VX-880 with chronic systemic immunosuppression)
ALLO_NONE_UNEDITED_OR_SYSTEMIC_IMMUNOSUP.description: 0 genetic edits (K=0). Represents the unedited allogeneic SC-islet baseline: inside the immunosuppression-free evaluator, unedited allogeneic cells require a physical macro-encapsulation barrier (VX-264, NCT05791201; terminated March 2025 due to insufficient C-peptide across diffusion barrier), whereas clinical zimislecel (VX-880, NCT04786262 / NCT06832410) achieves insulin independence only via chronic systemic calcineurin/mTOR/anti-thymocyte immunosuppression outside the immunosuppression-free target product profile (Finding 025).

AUTO_NONE.label: No Intracellular Autoantigen Edits (Lean Default for Classical-MHC-Null Chassis A)
AUTO_NONE.description: Zero autoantigen edits. Eliminates direct classical HLA-A/B/C CD8+ autoantigen presentation when paired with B2M-/-, avoiding G6PC2-/- fasting glucose set-point downshift and SLC30A8-/- dense-core defects; residual indirect APC presentation is modeled explicitly.

AUTO_DUAL_INS_LEADER_AND_DRIP_EDIT.label: Base-Edit of INS Signal Peptide (PPI) + Silent INS-DRiP AUG Removal
AUTO_DUAL_INS_LEADER_AND_DRIP_EDIT.description: 1 multiplex base-edit locus (B=1) at INS removing out-of-frame INS-DRiP initiation and/or replacing PPI signal peptide (PMID:28263308, PMID:42690930).

AUTO_FULL_KO_G6PC2_SLC30A8_PLUS_BASE_INS.label: Gross Pan-Autoantigen/GWAS KO (G6PC2-/- + SLC30A8-/- + PTPN2-/-, 3 cuts) + 4-Locus Base/Prime Edits (INS, GAD2, IAPP, CXADR)
AUTO_FULL_KO_G6PC2_SLC30A8_PLUS_BASE_INS.description: High-burden 7-target autoantigen/GWAS modification: K=3 chromosomal DSB knockouts (G6PC2-/-, SLC30A8-/-, and high-pLI negative-feedback brake PTPN2-/- [gnomAD v4 pLI = 0.990]) + B=4 nickase base/prime-edit loci (INS, high-pLI paracrine GABA enzyme GAD2 [gnomAD v4 pLI = 1.000], IAPP, CXADR). Incurs G6PC2-/- fasting glucose set-point downshift hazard (PMID:32569842, PMID:34954144), Graveyard 007 high-pLI KO/coding-disruption block on PTPN2-/- and multiplex GAD2 disruption (PMID:19336676, PMID:32432213), and multiplex nickase DSB/translocation penalty (PMID:39529170).

CYTO_CXCL10_SWAP_PDL1_SERPINB9.label: CXCL10::SERPINB9-GSG-tPT2A-PD-L1 (or CXCL10::PD-L1-P2A-SERPINB9 Endogenous CXCL10 KO + Inflammation-Inducible Swap-In)
CYTO_CXCL10_SWAP_PDL1_SERPINB9.description: 1 chromosomal cut at CXCL10 exon 1: deletes graft CXCL10 chemokine and expresses Granzyme-B inhibitor SERPINB9 + PD-L1 under native IFN/NF-kB inflammation control (comparing inverted SERPINB9-GSG-tPT2A-PD-L1 against PD-L1-GSG-tPT2A-SERPINB9 in Decision Experiment #3; Yoshihara et al. 2020 PMID:32814902; Sintov et al. 2022 PMID:36055241; Parent et al. 2021 PMID:34407395; Liu et al. 2017 PMID:28526819).

CYTO_CONSTITUTIVE_IL10_VIRAL_OE.label: Constitutive Viral IL-10 Overexpression (1 locus — Graveyard 008 Mast-Cell/Granulocyte Trap)
CYTO_CONSTITUTIVE_IL10_VIRAL_OE.description: 1 viral/transgenic locus constitutively secreting IL-10. Fails to provide durable alloprotection while risking local mast-cell/granulocyte expansion (mechanistic mast-cell expansion context: Polukort et al. 2016 PMID:27183617).

CYTO_STAT1_OR_TYK2_CLONAL_KO_WITH_GAS_IN.label: Clonal STAT1-/- + GAS/ISRE-Inducible PD-L1 (Epistatic Trap — Graveyard 001)
CYTO_STAT1_OR_TYK2_CLONAL_KO_WITH_GAS_IN.description: 1 cut (STAT1 KO) paired with a STAT1-dependent GAS/ISRE promoter (silences inducible PD-L1; Sintov et al. 2022 PMID:36055241).

CYTO_NONE.label: No Intrinsic Cytokine or Granzyme Shield
CYTO_NONE.description: Zero intrinsic protection against IFN-gamma/IL-1beta/TNF-alpha or Granzyme B bystander killing.

ER_NONE.label: No Intrinsic ER/Amyloid Gene Edit (Relies on Stage 7 Metabolic Maturation)
ER_NONE.description: 0 extra cuts. Avoids the human iPSC-beta RNLS-/- elevated basal OCR / metabolic precaution prior (noting that poor dynamic GSIS persisted in both WT and RNLS KO in MacDonald et al. 2025 Fig. 6, PMID:39988068).

ER_RNLS_KO.label: Biallelic RNLS-/- Knockout (1 cut)
ER_RNLS_KO.description: 1 chromosomal cut (RNLS KO). Protects beta-cells against thapsigargin ER stress and CTL killing in mouse NIT-1 / SC-beta screens (Cai et al. 2020 PMID:32719542), while carrying a conservative human iPSC-beta basal OCR / metabolic precaution prior (poor dynamic GSIS persisted in both WT and RNLS KO in MacDonald et al. 2025 Fig. 6, PMID:39988068).

ER_RNLS_KO_PLUS_IAPP_PRAMLINTIDE.label: RNLS-/- (1 cut) + IAPP (A25P/S28P/S29P) Prime-Edit (1 base/prime edit)
ER_RNLS_KO_PLUS_IAPP_PRAMLINTIDE.description: 1 cut (RNLS KO) + 1 prime-edit locus (IAPP proline conversion, PMID:18753660).

ER_IAPP_PRAMLINTIDE_RNLS_WT.label: RNLS+/+ (WT) + Non-Amyloidogenic IAPP (A25P/S28P/S29P) Prime-Edit (0 cuts, 1 prime edit)
ER_IAPP_PRAMLINTIDE_RNLS_WT.description: 0 chromosomal DSB cuts + 1 scarless prime-edit converting amyloidogenic human IAPP20-29 to non-amyloidogenic proline-substituted pramlintide-like IAPP(A25P/S28P/S29P) while preserving wild-type RNLS metabolic fitness (eliminating the human iPSC-beta RNLS-/- OCR/GSIS precaution prior in MacDonald et al. 2025 PMID:39988068 while directly blocking human IAPP oligomer toxicity in primary/SC-islets per Potter et al. 2010 PMID:20160085 and Thorngren et al. 2024 PMID:38603470, and noting that A25P/S28P/S29P converts soluble monomers while seeding/conformational effects require empirical Thioflavin-T/Congo-red qualification per Wang et al. 2014 PMID:25140605; AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

NICHE_TRIHORMONAL_120UM_MVF_CAO2.label: Stage 7 Tri-Hormonal (60/30/10, <=120 um) + iEC Microvessels + 14d Pre-Vasc Pouch + 72h PDMS-CaO2/Catalase
NICHE_TRIHORMONAL_120UM_MVF_CAO2.description: Vascularized (non-retrievable without surgical excision / iCasp9 ablation) micro-pocket with <=120 um clusters (R <= 60 um, strictly below both the conservative rat islet 74.6 um R_crit and the Stage 7 human SC-islet R_crit = sqrt(6*D*C_0/V_max) = 92.6 um [185.2 um diameter] at V_max = 0.034 mol/m^3/s; PMID:35241836, PMID:34480863) and hydrophobic PDMS-CaO2 (OxySite) + catalase oxygen bridge (noting that 0.7915 g [791.5 mg / 10.981 mmol] is the total loaded pure CaO2 inventory across 200 cm^2 [of which 0.4116 g / 52.0% hydrolyzes over the 72-h window at t_1/2 = 68 h, embedded in 3.166 g / 2.533 g / 1.706 g total PDMS-CaO2 composite mass at 25.0 / 31.25 / 46.39 wt% for Layouts A / B / Design X; delivering 0.4116 g reacted CaO2 at an empirical 72-h utilization fraction f_72h = 0.45 requires 0.915 g pure CaO2 [2.033 g composite at 45 wt%], whereas Pedraza et al. 2012 PMID:22371586 validated multi-week bulk PDMS-CaO2 disk release [f_72h ~= 0.0888 -> 4.635 g pure CaO2 for 0.4116 g reacted, or 8.91 g if scaling the full 0.7915 g inventory by 1/0.0888] and Montazeri et al. 2016 PMID:26970510 used PVP/H2O2-PLGA microparticles, so 72-h burst-matched <=150 um PDMS-CaO2 kinetics require Stage-1 empirical calibration; DEC-078]).

NICHE_NAKED_AVASCULAR_TRANSPLANT.label: Standard Avascular Islet Cluster Transplant (~150-250 um, No Pre-Vasc or O2 Bridge)
NICHE_NAKED_AVASCULAR_TRANSPLANT.description: Acute avascular injection suffering 50-70% 72h ischemic core loss.

NICHE_UNEDITED_MACRODEVICE_ENCAPSULATION.label: Avascular Cell-Impermeable Macro-Encapsulation Device (VX-264 / PEC-Encap style)
NICHE_UNEDITED_MACRODEVICE_ENCAPSULATION.description: Retrievable physical barrier (>150-200 um diffusion distance) causing central hypoxia and fibrotic foreign-body reaction.

SAF_AAVS1_CAG_ICASP9_BIALLELIC.label: Biallelic AAVS1-[455bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE)]-EEF1A1-core-iCasp9 (or AAVS1-CAG-iCasp9 / GAPDH-P2A-iCasp9) Pan-Lineage Safe-Harbor Switch (1 locus)
SAF_AAVS1_CAG_ICASP9_BIALLELIC.description: 1 safe-harbor locus knocked in biallelically (3,457 bp donor / 3,747 bp with ITRs <= 4,700 bp single-AAV6 limit; insulated with 455 bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE alias; insulation function pending) + cHS4 boundaries driving EEF1A1-core-iCasp9; Muller-Kuller et al. 2015 PMID:25605798; Zhang et al. 2017 PMID:28860464; Pfaff et al. 2013 PMID:23307570; Ordovas et al. 2015 PMID:26455413) so undifferentiated iPSCs, endocrine cells, and off-target SLC18A1+ cells are erasable by AP1903/rimiducid (<10^-8 target escape bound per colony-forming proliferating cell; Wunderlich et al. 2022 PMID:35795779).

SAF_G6PC2_ENDOGENOUS_ICASP9.label: G6PC2::iCasp9 Mature-Beta-Restricted Switch (1 locus — Graveyard 002 Escape Risk)
SAF_G6PC2_ENDOGENOUS_ICASP9.description: 1 locus (G6PC2 KO + iCasp9 KI). Fails to ablate dedifferentiated, teratoma, or SLC18A1+ off-target cells (Yagyu 2016 PMID:27626039).

SAF_NONE.label: No Suicide Switch
SAF_NONE.description: Zero pharmacological erasability in the event of viral infection or oncogenic transformation.

triggered.evaluator_disposition_rule: Applies -0.20 logit discount in Gate 3 + requires Decision Experiment #1 QuantiBRITE gate
triggered.reason: Requires QuantiBRITE Hour-0 verification that resting endogenous B2M promoter achieves inhibitory HLA-E and CD47 surface density on Stage 7 beta-cells and iECs (Han 2019 PMID:31040209; Hu 2023 PMID:37156915; Xu 2024 PMID:38508139; Lin 2023 PMID:37264229).

triggered.evaluator_disposition_rule: Applies -0.25 logit discount in Gate 2B + requires Decision Experiment #2 indirect APC / SA-FasL gate
triggered.reason: Donor MHC loss does not block host APC presentation of shed autoantigens and alloantigens. An INS leader/DRiP edit does not remove other epitopes or establish indirect immune protection; the warning remains until exact-product assays qualify the residual hazard (PMID:28263308, PMID:36055241, PMID:35559682).
Lineage-restricted (G6PC2::iCasp9) suicide switch fails to ablate dedifferentiated, teratoma, or SLC18A1+ off-target cells (PMID:27626039, PMID:35795779).
Precautionary mechanistic hazard: Biallelic G6PC2-/- shifts the beta-cell glucose dose-response curve leftward and lowers fasting blood glucose (Bosma 2020 PMID:32569842; Overway 2022 PMID:34954144).

triggered.reason: Donor MHC loss does not block host APC presentation of shed autoantigens and alloantigens.
